bead.title: Implement bounded hot projection aggregate queries
bead.description:
PROBLEM
Cayce-style hot reporting needs bounded grouped counts over indexed hot records: hourly/status distribution, recycling preview buckets, and engagement-probability segments. pqueue must provide generic grouping primitives without arbitrary SQL or Snorri-specific policy.

PROPOSED FIX
Implement bounded aggregate query support over declared typed indexes for memory and sqlite: hour(scheduled_at) grouping, status/boolean grouping, scheduler/action filters, and declared numeric/null buckets for a numeric typed field. Reject unsupported expressions and unbounded result sizes explicitly.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-core query aggregate types if small extensions are needed.
- crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs.
- crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs.
- crates/pqueue/tests/hot_projection_queries.rs.

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Arbitrary SQL/JSONPath/expression execution.
- Snorri open-rate business policy.
- Long-retention analytics.

DECLARED BUCKETS AND NULLS
Buckets are caller-declared per the contract (pqueue-b1feb686); the test declares exactly the bucket list in the acceptance criteria. act_004 (engagement_probability = null) must land in the declared no-activity bucket via the contract's null-handling rule — it is absent from the numeric typed index, so the implementation cannot derive that count from the index alone.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue --test hot_projection_queries hourly_distribution_by_status -- --nocapture` passes with exactly: 2026-07-02T14:00Z {scheduled: 2}, 2026-07-02T15:00Z {scheduled: 1, suppressed: 1}, 2026-07-03T09:00Z {failed: 1} — for action_type=message.send over window [2026-07-02T00:00Z, 2026-07-04T00:00Z); act_006 is excluded by the action_type filter.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue --test hot_projection_queries recycling_preview_by_hour -- --nocapture` passes with exactly: 2026-07-02T14:00Z {suppressed_by_recycling=true: 1, false: 1}, 2026-07-02T15:00Z {true: 1, false: 1}, 2026-07-03T09:00Z {false: 1} — same filter and window.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue --test hot_projection_queries engagement_probability_segments -- --nocapture` passes with declared buckets: exact 0 -> "0%" = 1 (act_003), (0.08, 0.10] -> "8.01-10%" = 1 (act_001), (0.10, 0.15] -> "10.01-15%" = 1 (act_002), (0.45, 0.50] -> "45.01-50%" = 1 (act_005), null -> "no-activity" = 1 (act_004); act_006 excluded by the action_type=message.send filter.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
